proto 9 math.min(25, newScore) / math.min(25, newScore - delta) buff stacks

limits.basis: operand domain guard only; gameplay-safe range not established offline

tunables.evidence: Clamp(score+delta,0,25) then SetNetPersistentVar in proto 13 L1134-1137, 15 L1320, 16 L1451, 25 L2234-2236 (+1), 27 (3 sites) = 7 sites. The same maximum is repeated as math.min(25, score) where the score becomes buff stacks: proto 9 L830-836 (called after every clamp with (delta,newScore,avatar)) and proto 31 L3307. Changing only the clamp would leave the buff capped at the old value, so all 10 sites are one control (Phase 1 unit "stacks"). p2d_sx 25: 10 LOADN 25 sites, all covered; P8 K19 MULK 25 is a vector offset (L666), unrelated.
tunables.backend_note: 10 exact site(s) patched together: Clamp(score + delta, 0, 25) before SetNetPersistentVar(RESURRECTION_SCORE_*); proto 9 math.min(25, newScore) / math.min(25, newScore - delta) buff stacks; proto 31 math.min(25, GetResurrectionScore(avatar)) buff stacks

ui_rules.checkbox_label: "Custom " + short_label; must fit label_budget (the first letter may be lower-cased for display, which does not change the length)
ui_rules.editor_label: short_label + " (stock " + stock_display + unit_suffix + ")" when that fits label_budget; otherwise short_label alone, and the tooltip starts with the stock value
ui_rules.stock_display: whole numbers without a decimal point; otherwise up to 6 significant digits (%.6g)
ui_rules.unit_suffix: unit "x" appended without a space; any other non-empty unit after one space; empty unit: nothing
ui_rules.editor_rule: TOGGLE for enum; INPUTCOUNT for int with min >= 0 (max always set); INPUTBOX otherwise
ui_rules.applies_rule: addon live_next_read; literal next_mission; metadata restart; server server_reload
